description: This file contains a Roslyn analyzer class GenerateGenerateSerializerAttributeAnalyzer that inspects C# code to identify class, struct, record, or record struct declarations missing a specific serializer attribute, and reports diagnostics for them.

classes.name: GenerateGenerateSerializerAttributeAnalyzer
classes.description: A DiagnosticAnalyzer that enforces the presence of a GenerateSerializer attribute on relevant type declarations.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Analyzes a syntax node of class, struct, record, or record struct declaration to determine if it is missing a serializer attribute and reports a diagnostic if necessary.
